newsitem.title: USA: CBOE, PHLX, PCX plan Fore Systems LEAPS.
newsitem.headline: CBOE, PHLX, PCX plan Fore Systems LEAPS.

text.p: Three U.S. exchanges Friday said they would trade Long-term Equity Anticipation Securities (LEAPS) on the shares of FORE Systems Inc.

The Chicago Board Options Exchange, Pacific Exchange, and Philadelphia Stock Exchange join the American Stock Exchange in offering FORE Systems Inc LEAPS beginning April 21. AMEX previously announced its plans to offer the LEAPS.
At all four exchanges, the LEAPS will open with strike prices of 10, 15 and 20 and trade under the ticker symbol VFY.
FORE Systems makes networking products based on asynchronous tranfer mode technology.
